data_testid_convention.rule: Every button, link, interactive card, tab, form element, section wrapper, and text readout MUST have a data-testid attribute in lower-kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and integrate Google Fonts Cormorant Garamond and Plus Jakarta Sans in public/index.html or index.css.
Implement Lenis or smooth window scrolling for seamless navigation across sections.
Ensure ALL WhatsApp buttons link directly to https://wa.me/5548992118889 with pre-filled message.
Strictly follow the color palette (#B05B4B, #C06C5C, #2C1810, #FDFBF7, #FAF0EE). Do NOT use forbidden pinks, purples, or greens.

Build elegant Senhorita M branded placeholder frames with subtle terracotta badge text ('Foto do Salão — Em Breve' / 'Resultado Real — Em Breve'). Do NOT use generic placeholder URLs or AI stock images.
Ensure every interactive element has a unique, role-based data-testid attribute.
Build interactive Before/After comparison slider in the Resultados section.
Add responsive mobile drawer navigation with quick WhatsApp CTA.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered AI layouts; use high-fashion asymmetrical grids and generous whitespace.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on fixed or floating headers; use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque cream/bone white.
All buttons must feature tactile hover states (-translate-y-0.5, shadow-md, smooth color transition).
Ensure full accessibility compliance with minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratios for all body text against backgrounds.
